title: ResumeScreeningOutput
description: Required JSON output schema for LLM resume screening. Every response MUST conform to this schema.

decision.description: The screening decision. 'accept' = candidate clearly meets requirements; 'reject' = candidate does not meet requirements; 'needs_review' = partial match requiring human review.

confidence.description: Confidence score from 0.0 (no confidence) to 1.0 (fully confident). Must reflect actual evidence strength, not assumptions.

evidence.description: List of evidence items. Each quote MUST be an exact substring from the provided resume text. Do NOT fabricate or paraphrase.

quote.description: An EXACT substring copied from the resume text. Must appear verbatim in the resume.

relevance.description: Brief explanation of how this quote relates to the job requirement.

reason.description: One-paragraph justification for the decision. Must reference only information present in the resume. Must not introduce external knowledge or assumptions.

flags.description: Optional flags for special conditions detected during screening.
